explanation: The requested phi*=370 degrees is outside EXCLURAD's accepted [0,360] range but is physically equivalent to 10 degrees, so it was normalized modulo 360. The corrected eta point (W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=10 degrees) passed all EXCLURAD preflight checks and was generated using the eta campaign defaults: 6.53 GeV beam energy, vcut=0.166 GeV^2, and full O(alpha) radiative corrections. manifest.csv was also generated alongside the input.
